purpose: Keep the existing blessing content usable as a typed, authority-safe roguelike reward surface while making the missing burden design and runtime consumer explicit.

source_content.row_identity: Rows key and blessing_id must match exactly
validation: effect_type is authored and never inferred from display text
unknown effect types are surfaced to the catalog validator

presentation.rule: The widget renders an authority-owned candidate and never computes cost, applies effects, mutates save state, or chooses a currency.

runtime_authority.fail_closed_rule: Do not bind token_cost to a currency until exactly one authority and one atomic spend/apply/refund transaction are selected.

rules: A burden is a typed negative or constraining modifier, not a renamed blessing.
A burden must be authored as content before the UI advertises it as selectable.
A burden must use the same atomic candidate transaction as a blessing choice.
No burden may directly mutate save, wallet, battle, or traversal state from the widget.

dungeon_builder_boundary.persistence_rule: Keep UMelodiaRoguelikePersistence quarantined until overlapping profile ownership is migrated into the canonical save record.

acceptance: A typed catalog loads the authored 26 blessing rows without raw JSON runtime reads.
Exactly one currency authority performs an atomic spend/apply/refund transaction.
WBP_BlessingBurden renders candidates from the typed authority and is replay-safe.
Burden rows exist and validate before the burden card is marked gameplay-ready.
BP_RoguelikeDungeonGenerator live reflection proves the recipe-consumer interface.
Room entrance arrival and reset behavior are exercised on a disposable room route.
No roguelike persistence surface duplicates wardrobe ownership or narrative progression.
